signal: Eventus won Market Surveillance Solution of the Year at the FOW International Awards 2026 for its Validus platform and launched its Frank natural-language AI tool

email.body1:
Mikhail, saw Eventus take Market Surveillance Solution of the Year at FOW and ship the Frank AI tool for Validus.

Awards and AI launches usually surface more in-market firms than a regional team can cover before they cool, especially across North America. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Eventus off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mikhail, quick follow-up for Eventus.

When recognition drives demand, coverage gaps in a region show up before anyone notices. Most reps don't know how many meetings North America actually needs to hit target, so the math breaks quietly.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings the North America territory needs this quarter, and where it breaks if coverage stays manual.
email.body3:
Mikhail, last bit of proof for Eventus.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Eventus' reply rate likely compares to other enterprise regtech companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mikhail, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling North America pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running a region is busy enough.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a regtech field motion? I'll tailor it to Eventus either way.
